raw_text: SIGINT indicates INS Arihant has departed Visakhapatnam submarine base for what appears to be a deterrence patrol. VLF communications from INS Kattabomman transmitter station show increased activity pattern consistent with SSBN deployment. Chinese maritime surveillance assets in the Indian Ocean appear to be tracking the submarine. This is a significant development — Arihant carrying K-15 Sagarika missiles extends India's second-strike capability.
